vnum0.name: Academy Entrance
vnum0.desc:
You step into the gleaming entrance hall of the academy. Polished durasteel
floors reflectthe glow of overhead lights, and banners of past graduates hang
proudly along the walls.A hovering droid floats nearby, scanning newcomers with
quiet beeps.
